title: To designate the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 109 Live Oaks Boulevard in Casselberry, Florida, as the "Colonel Joseph William Kittinger II Post Office Building".
official_summary: This act designates the facility of the U.S. Postal Service located at 109 Live Oaks Boulevard in Casselberry, Florida, as the Colonel Joseph William Kittinger II Post Office Building.

summary.headline: Names a post office building in Casselberry, Florida after Colonel Joseph William Kittinger II.
summary.what_it_does: This law renames the U.S. Postal Service facility at 109 Live Oaks Boulevard in Casselberry, Florida, as the Colonel Joseph William Kittinger II Post Office Building. It is an honorary designation and does not change how the post office operates or the services it provides.
